the heat transfer enhancement for CO 2 / propane mixtures was achieved with a micro fin tube and it was more effective for a higher mass flux, a higher heat flux and a lower composition of CO 2 in the mixtures.
the enhancement factor of micro fin tubes is higher than smooth tubes and penalty factor is lower than smooth tubes for the CO 2 / propane mixtures.

micro fin tube can be used for CO 2 / propane mixtures with high heat transfer coefficients, which is a promising technology to reduce the size of heat exchangers and improve their performance.
